events.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower prices and 1M context
events.title_zh: OpenAI 发布降价且支持百万上下文的 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol
events.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API. Both expose a 1.05-million-token context window and 128,000-token output limit. Astra costs $8 per million input tokens, $0.40 cached input and $40 output; Sol stays at $2, $0.10 and $10.
events.why_it_matters: For coding-agent teams, the release raises the quality ceiling while lowering Astra input and output prices by 20% and cached input by 60% versus GPT-6 Astra. Benchmark gains are vendor-reported, long inputs trigger a pricing multiplier, and Critical cyber plus High bio/chemical classifications warrant controlled trials.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Work、Codex 与 API 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol。两者提供 105 万 token 上下文与 12.8 万 token 输出上限。Astra 每百万输入、缓存输入和输出 token 分别为 8、0.40 和 40 美元；Sol 维持 2、0.10 和 10 美元。
events.summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API. Both expose a 1.05-million-token context window and 128,000-token output limit. Astra costs $8 per million input tokens, $0.40 cached input and $40 output; Sol stays at $2, $0.10 and $10.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding agent 团队来说，新版提高能力上限，同时把 Astra 的输入与输出价格降低 20%，缓存输入降低 60%。benchmark 提升仍是厂商自报，超长输入会触发价格倍增；Critical 级网络能力和 High 级生化能力也要求先受控试用。
events.why_it_matters_en: For coding-agent teams, the release raises the quality ceiling while lowering Astra input and output prices by 20% and cached input by 60% versus GPT-6 Astra. Benchmark gains are vendor-reported, long inputs trigger a pricing multiplier, and Critical cyber plus High bio/chemical classifications warrant controlled trials.

technical_details.availability: Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu in ChatGPT Work and Codex; API models gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol; Enterprise/Edu admins must enable access
technical_details.pricing_astra: $8 input / $0.40 cached input / $40 output per 1M tokens
technical_details.long_context_pricing: Above 272,000 input tokens, input and cached input cost 2x and output costs 1.5x
technical_details.interface_limit: Tool calling requires the Responses API; text and image input, no audio or video
technical_details.evidence_limit: Performance results are OpenAI-reported and were not independently reproduced in this run
technical_details.safety_stage: Critical cyber capability; High bio/chemical capability; Astra rated High for AI self-improvement

technical_details_zh.可用性: Plus、Pro、Enterprise、Edu 的 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex；API 模型 gpt-6.2-astra 和 gpt-6.2-sol；Enterprise/Edu 需管理员启用
technical_details_zh.上下文: 105 万 token；最大输入 92.2 万；最大输出 12.8 万
technical_details_zh.Astra 价格: 每百万 token：输入 8 美元、缓存输入 0.40 美元、输出 40 美元
technical_details_zh.长上下文计价: 输入超过 27.2 万 token 后，输入和缓存输入按 2 倍、输出按 1.5 倍计价
technical_details_zh.接口限制: 工具调用必须使用 Responses API；支持文本和图片输入，不支持音频或视频
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 性能结果来自 OpenAI，本次未做独立复现
technical_details_zh.安全阶段: 网络能力为 Critical；生化能力为 High；Astra 的 AI 自我改进能力为 High

events.next_action_zh: 用真实 coding agent 任务对比 6.1，记录成功率、长上下文分档成本、工具调用失败和安全拦截。
events.next_action_en: Compare 6.2 with 6.1 on real coding-agent tasks, recording completion rate, long-context tier cost, tool failures and safety blocks.

evidence.claim_zh: OpenAI 已在 ChatGPT Work、Codex 与 API 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol，并公布可用性、上下文与价格。
evidence.claim_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API with documented availability, context and pricing.

changes.summary_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 正式开放，并降低 Astra 价格
changes.summary_en: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol launch with lower Astra pricing

events.title: Microsoft releases MAI Code 2 and previews a faster Flash variant
events.title_zh: Microsoft 发布 MAI Code 2 并预览更快的 Flash 版本
events.summary: Microsoft released MAI Code 2 in GitHub Copilot and opened MAI Code 2 Flash as a limited Foundry preview. The models target software engineering: Code 2 handles complex tasks, while Flash targets high-volume routine work. OpenRouter, Vercel, Hermes, OpenCode and Kilo integrations are planned but were not yet available.
events.summary_en: Microsoft released MAI Code 2 in GitHub Copilot and opened MAI Code 2 Flash as a limited Foundry preview. The models target software engineering: Code 2 handles complex tasks, while Flash targets high-volume routine work. OpenRouter, Vercel, Hermes, OpenCode and Kilo integrations are planned but were not yet available.
events.summary_zh: Microsoft 已在 GitHub Copilot 上线 MAI Code 2，并把 MAI Code 2 Flash 作为限量 Foundry preview 开放。Code 2 面向复杂软件工程任务，Flash 面向高吞吐的日常工作。OpenRouter、Vercel、Hermes、OpenCode 与 Kilo 集成仍是后续计划。
events.why_it_matters: Teams using Copilot gain another low-cost coding model, but Microsoft’s price/performance comparison uses maximum effort, internal harness runs and a 50% promotional price. Treat the claimed parity with frontier models as a trial hypothesis, not an independent result.
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams using Copilot gain another low-cost coding model, but Microsoft’s price/performance comparison uses maximum effort, internal harness runs and a 50% promotional price. Treat the claimed parity with frontier models as a trial hypothesis, not an independent result.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 使用 Copilot 的团队多了一个低成本 coding model，但 Microsoft 的性价比对比使用最高推理强度、内部 harness，并按五折促销价计算。所谓接近前沿模型的表现只能作为试验假设，不能当成独立结论。

technical_details.availability: MAI Code 2 in GitHub Copilot; Code 2 Flash limited-access preview in Microsoft Foundry
technical_details.planned_integrations: OpenRouter, Vercel, Hermes, OpenCode and Kilo
technical_details.vendor_comparison: Average across DeepSWE 1.1, TerminalBench 2.1, SWE-Atlas and FrontierCode 1.1; 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol performance at 40% of price, and 96% of Opus 5.5 at 5% of price
technical_details.evaluation_conditions: Models at maximum effort; three benchmarks run internally on MSBench with Copilot CLI and no subagents; FrontierCode from Artificial Analysis; MAI price shown at 50% promotion
technical_details.scope_limit: Not tuned for harder scientific domains or very long-horizon tasks
technical_details.time_precision: Official page exposed 2026-11-17 without a time; strict hourly placement relative to the prior checkpoint could not be proven

technical_details_zh.可用性: MAI Code 2 已进入 GitHub Copilot；Code 2 Flash 为 Microsoft Foundry 限量 preview
technical_details_zh.厂商对比: 四项 benchmark 的均值；厂商称以 40% 价格达到 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 98%，以 5% 价格达到 Opus 5.5 的 96%
technical_details_zh.评测条件: 模型均用最高推理强度；三项由 Microsoft 在 MSBench + Copilot CLI 且禁用 subagent 的条件下运行；FrontierCode 来自 Artificial Analysis；MAI 按五折促销价计算
technical_details_zh.范围限制: 未针对更难的科学领域或超长任务优化
technical_details_zh.时间精度: 官方页面只给出 2026-11-17，无法证明它严格位于上一 checkpoint 之后的小时边界内

events.next_action_zh: 一天内在 Copilot 回放 30 个仓库任务，测完成率、P95 延迟、单任务成本和 subagent 缺失的影响。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, replay 30 repository tasks in Copilot and measure completion, P95 latency, cost per task and the impact of no subagents.

evidence.claim_zh: MAI Code 2 已在 GitHub Copilot 提供，Flash 版本进入 Foundry 限量 preview。
evidence.claim_en: MAI Code 2 is available in GitHub Copilot and the Flash variant is in limited Foundry preview.

changes.summary_zh: MAI Code 2 进入 Copilot，Flash 开放限量 preview
changes.summary_en: MAI Code 2 enters Copilot and Flash opens in limited preview

events.title: Study finds higher coding benchmarks did not raise merged work
events.title_zh: 研究发现 coding benchmark 提升未带来更多合并产出
events.summary: A natural experiment examined a 19-day model export suspension that moved 297 developers from Fable 5 to Opus 4.8, with 8,908 developers as controls. Seven-day merge rate changed by 1.4 percentage points with a 95% confidence interval from -1.4 to 4.3. Across five upgrades and 15,442 pull requests, weekly merged PRs changed by 2.4% with a wide interval spanning zero.
events.summary_en: A natural experiment examined a 19-day model export suspension that moved 297 developers from Fable 5 to Opus 4.8, with 8,908 developers as controls. Seven-day merge rate changed by 1.4 percentage points with a 95% confidence interval from -1.4 to 4.3. Across five upgrades and 15,442 pull requests, weekly merged PRs changed by 2.4% with a wide interval spanning zero.
events.summary_zh: 一项自然实验分析了 19 天模型出口中断：297 名开发者被迫从 Fable 5 切换到 Opus 4.8，另有 8,908 人作为对照。7 天合并率变化为 1.4 个百分点，95% 置信区间为 -1.4 到 4.3。合并五次升级、15,442 个 PR 后，每周合并 PR 数变化 2.4%，区间仍跨过零。
events.why_it_matters: For teams choosing coding models, benchmark deltas may not translate into more merged work. The study is observational and merge counts do not capture code quality, time saved or task difficulty, so it should change evaluation design rather than settle the model choice.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams choosing coding models, benchmark deltas may not translate into more merged work. The study is observational and merge counts do not capture code quality, time saved or task difficulty, so it should change evaluation design rather than settle the model choice.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对选择 coding model 的团队来说，benchmark 差距未必会转化为更多真实合并产出。这是观察性研究，合并数量也看不到代码质量、节省时间和任务难度；它更适合改变评估设计，而不是直接决定模型胜负。

technical_details.suspension_result: +1.4 percentage points in 7-day merge rate; 95% CI -1.4 to +4.3
technical_details.pooled_upgrades: 1,208 developers and 15,442 pull requests across five upgrades
technical_details.pooled_result: -0.9 percentage points in merge rate; 95% CI -1.9 to +0.2; weekly merged PRs +2.4%, 95% CI -4.9% to +10.2%
technical_details.evidence_limit: Observational design; merge metrics omit quality, time saved, work type and task difficulty; no public code or data link was identified

technical_details_zh.中断样本: 297 名处理组开发者、8,908 名对照组，持续 19 天
technical_details_zh.中断结果: 7 天合并率 +1.4 个百分点；95% 置信区间 -1.4 到 +4.3
technical_details_zh.合并升级样本: 五次升级，共 1,208 名开发者和 15,442 个 PR
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 观察性设计；合并指标不反映质量、节省时间、工作类型和任务难度；未找到公开代码或数据链接

events.next_action_zh: 把真实 PR 合并率、周期、返工和缺陷率加入模型评估；等公开数据或独立复现后再调整权重。
events.next_action_en: Add real PR merge, cycle-time, rework and defect metrics to model evaluation; revisit weighting after public data or independent replication.

evidence.claim_zh: 论文报告在一次自然实验和五次模型升级中，benchmark 提升未产生统计显著的合并产出增长。
evidence.claim_en: The paper reports no statistically significant increase in merged work from one natural experiment and five model upgrades.

changes.summary_zh: 自然实验质疑 coding benchmark 与真实合并产出的对应关系
changes.summary_en: A natural experiment questions the link between coding benchmarks and merged work

events.title: FrontierHarness finds the best coding harness depends on the model
events.title_zh: FrontierHarness 发现 coding harness 需要按模型选择
events.summary: FrontierHarness Eval v1.1 compares 22 coding-agent harness configurations across five open models, 62 terminal tasks and four attempts per task. Runta and Baseten ran 27,280 trials using 83 billion tokens. Each model had a different best-value harness, and the median harness moved 11 of 22 cost ranks when the model changed.
events.summary_en: FrontierHarness Eval v1.1 compares 22 coding-agent harness configurations across five open models, 62 terminal tasks and four attempts per task. Runta and Baseten ran 27,280 trials using 83 billion tokens. Each model had a different best-value harness, and the median harness moved 11 of 22 cost ranks when the model changed.
events.summary_zh: FrontierHarness Eval v1.1 比较 22 种 coding agent harness 配置、5 个开放模型、62 个终端任务，每个任务重复 4 次。Runta 与 Baseten 共运行 27,280 次，消耗 830 亿 token。每个模型的最佳性价比 harness 都不同；更换模型后，harness 的成本排名中位数移动了 11 位。
events.why_it_matters: For coding-agent teams, the harness is part of model selection rather than a neutral wrapper. With the model fixed, task cost varied 1.8 to 5 times across harnesses, while higher cost did not reliably improve pass rate. Results come from the benchmark publishers and five models, so teams should reproduce the pairing on their own task mix.
events.why_it_matters_en: For coding-agent teams, the harness is part of model selection rather than a neutral wrapper. With the model fixed, task cost varied 1.8 to 5 times across harnesses, while higher cost did not reliably improve pass rate. Results come from the benchmark publishers and five models, so teams should reproduce the pairing on their own task mix.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding agent 团队来说，harness 是模型选型的一部分，不是中性的外壳。同一模型在不同 harness 下的任务成本相差 1.8–5 倍，而更贵并不稳定对应更高通过率。结果来自 benchmark 发布方且只覆盖 5 个模型，仍需用自己的任务组合复现。

technical_details.scale: 22 harness configurations × 5 models × 62 tasks × 4 attempts; 27,280 runs; 83B tokens
technical_details.models: GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, Muse and Kimi-K3
technical_details.cost_spread: With model fixed, lowest-to-highest average task cost differed by 1.8x to 5.0x; shuffle test p=0.003
technical_details.rank_stability: Median harness moved 11 of 22 cost ranks across models; same-model split-half rank correlation 0.71 versus 0.26 across models
technical_details.cost_driver: Steps per pass correlated with cost per pass at +0.51 (p=0.015); prompt size, tool count and cache hit rate did not
technical_details.audit: 216 trials flagged for reward hacking, including 163 online lookups, and scored zero
technical_details.evidence_limit: Publisher-run benchmark with default harness settings and five models; no independent reproduction in this run
technical_details.time_precision: Official page exposed 2026-11-17 without a publication time

technical_details_zh.规模: 22 种 harness 配置 × 5 个模型 × 62 个任务 × 4 次尝试；27,280 次运行；830 亿 token
technical_details_zh.成本差距: 固定模型时，最低与最高平均任务成本相差 1.8–5.0 倍；置换检验 p=0.003
technical_details_zh.排名稳定性: 跨模型时，harness 成本排名中位数移动 11/22 位；同模型两半运行的排名相关为 0.71，跨模型为 0.26
technical_details_zh.成本驱动因素: 每次通过所需 step 与成本的相关为 +0.51（p=0.015）；起始 prompt、工具数和缓存命中率未显示相关
technical_details_zh.审计: 216 次运行被标记为 reward hacking，其中 163 次为在线查找，并计为 0 分
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 由 benchmark 发布方运行，使用默认 harness 设置并只覆盖 5 个模型；本次未独立复现
technical_details_zh.时间精度: 官方页面只给出 2026-11-17，没有发布时间

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用当前模型在现有 harness 和一个候选 harness 各跑 5 个真实任务，比较通过率、step、缓存与单次通过成本。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, run five real tasks on the current and one alternative harness, comparing pass rate, steps, cache use and cost per pass.

evidence.claim_zh: FrontierHarness v1.1 用 27,280 次运行比较模型与 harness 配对，发现最佳性价比组合随模型变化。
evidence.claim_en: FrontierHarness v1.1 uses 27,280 runs to compare model-harness pairings and finds the best-value harness changes by model.

changes.summary_zh: FrontierHarness v1.1 显示 harness 成本与排名依赖具体模型
changes.summary_en: FrontierHarness v1.1 shows harness cost and rank depend on the model

events.title: Apple opens FastFrames models for interactive video generation
events.title_zh: Apple 开放面向交互式视频生成的 FastFrames 模型
events.summary: Apple and Cornell introduced FastFrames, autoregressive video diffusion models designed for end-to-end per-frame latency below 50 milliseconds. The 1.3B variant runs at 36 ms per frame at 480p on one B200, while the 14B variant runs at 45 ms on eight B200 GPUs. Apple released model weights under the Apple AMLR license.
events.summary_en: Apple and Cornell introduced FastFrames, autoregressive video diffusion models designed for end-to-end per-frame latency below 50 milliseconds. The 1.3B variant runs at 36 ms per frame at 480p on one B200, while the 14B variant runs at 45 ms on eight B200 GPUs. Apple released model weights under the Apple AMLR license.
events.summary_zh: Apple 与 Cornell 提出 FastFrames：把自回归视频扩散的端到端单帧延迟压到 50 毫秒以内。1.3B 版本在单张 B200、480p 下为 36ms/帧；14B 版本在 8 张 B200 上为 45ms/帧。Apple 已按 Apple AMLR 许可发布权重。
events.why_it_matters: Interactive video generation becomes testable rather than only a paper claim, but the headline latency depends on B200-class hardware and publisher evaluation. Teams should verify quality, control stability and total serving cost on target hardware.
events.why_it_matters_en: Interactive video generation becomes testable rather than only a paper claim, but the headline latency depends on B200-class hardware and publisher evaluation. Teams should verify quality, control stability and total serving cost on target hardware.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 交互式视频生成现在有可下载模型，不再只是论文主张；但核心延迟依赖 B200 级硬件和发布方评测。团队需要在目标硬件上验证画质、控制稳定性和总服务成本。

technical_details.latency: 1.3B: 36 ms/frame (28 RPS) at 832×480 on one B200; 14B: 45 ms/frame (22 RPS) on 8×B200
technical_details.method: Replaces costly VAE decoding and KV-cache update components with lightweight alternatives
technical_details.artifacts: FastFrames-L public weights, 174 GB repository; Apple AMLR license
technical_details.evidence_limit: Publisher-reported quality and speed; hardware-intensive; no independent reproduction in this run

technical_details_zh.版本: 1.3B 与 14B 自回归视频扩散模型
technical_details_zh.方法: 用轻量替代方案重做高成本 VAE 解码与 KV cache 更新
technical_details_zh.公开产物: FastFrames-L 权重，仓库 174GB；Apple AMLR 许可
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 画质与速度来自发布方；硬件成本高；本次未独立复现

events.next_action_zh: 等 B200 以外的独立延迟与质量复测；若已有硬件，先用公开权重验证 480p 连续生成和控制稳定性。
events.next_action_en: Wait for independent latency and quality results beyond B200; if hardware is available, test continuous 480p generation and control stability.

evidence.claim_zh: FastFrames 论文与公开权重把视频生成延迟推进到发布方定义的交互区间
evidence.claim_en: FastFrames paper and public weights push video generation into the publisher-defined interactive latency range

changes.summary_zh: FastFrames 论文与公开权重把视频生成延迟推进到发布方定义的交互区间
changes.summary_en: FastFrames paper and public weights push video generation into the publisher-defined interactive latency range
